Selected Work

Industrial Robot Workcell Design Platform

Anonymized Engineering Case · Software Delivered · Verified engineering delivery · Illustrative demonstration

Turn operating requirements, facility drawings and robot constraints into reviewable 2D and 3D workcell proposals.

Discuss a similar project Open the synthetic scenario Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Palletizing workcells require trade-offs among facility dimensions, robot reachability, cycle time and equipment cost. A usable layout depends on coordinate systems, equipment specifications and operating constraints. Each candidate must retain its assumptions so engineers can check and compare it.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

Historical engineering documentation describes nine sequential backend stages covering layout search, cycle-time estimation, metric enrichment, clustering and ranking, motion verification, candidate selection, camera layout, safety fencing and site objects, and final output. Cycle times are estimates for candidate designs.

Outcome

The design workflow produces CAD, a bill of materials and layout candidates for engineering review.

  • Workcell design platform
  • CAD and equipment bill of materials
  • Layouts and assumptions for engineering review

Validation and evidence

The published scope covers a software design delivery. Layout checks and cycle-time estimates apply to the configured task and constraints. Factory acceptance depends on the physical equipment and site.

Design software was delivered. Cycle times are planning estimates.
